description: This is a test class for the ShelfController in a book management application. It contains unit tests for methods such as retrieving all shelves, creating new shelves, renaming shelves, and deleting shelves, primarily using mocked dependencies. The tests verify behaviors like handling of empty lists, duplicates, validity of shelf names, and proper exception handling.

classes.name: ShelfControllerTest
classes.description: Unit test suite for ShelfController, testing CRUD operations and validation logic for shelf management.

methods.name: all_returnsEmptyList_whenNoShelvesExist
methods.description: Tests that the 'all' method returns an empty list when no shelves are present.

methods.name: all_returnsNonEmptyList_whenPredefinedShelvesExist
methods.description: Verifies that the 'all' method returns predefined shelves when they exist.

methods.name: all_returnsNonEmptyList_whenUserCreatedShelvesExist
methods.description: Verifies that the 'all' method returns user-created shelves when they exist.

methods.name: all_returnsNonCombinedList_whenBothPredefinedAndUserCreatedShelvesExist
methods.description: Verifies that the 'all' method returns a combined list of predefined and user-created shelves.

methods.name: create_returnsBadRequest_ifShelfNameTaken
methods.description: Checks that creating a shelf with an existing name returns a 400 Bad Request.

methods.name: create_throws_ifNoNameOrEmptyNameSpecified
methods.description: Ensures that creating a shelf with null or empty name results in a BAD_REQUEST response.

methods.name: renameShelf_ThrowsIfNoNameOrEmptyNameSpecifiedForLocatingShelf
methods.description: Verifies that renaming a shelf with null or empty old name throws a BAD_REQUEST.

methods.name: renameShelf_ThrowsIfNoNameOrEmptyNameSpecifiedForNewName
methods.description: Verifies that renaming a shelf with null or empty new name throws a BAD_REQUEST.

methods.name: renameShelf_ThrowsIfUserCreatedShelfDoesNotExist
methods.description: Tests that renaming a non-existent shelf results in an NOT_FOUND error.

methods.name: deleteShelf_returnsBadRequest_ifShelfNameIsBlank
methods.description: Checks that deleting a shelf with a blank name returns BAD_REQUEST.

methods.name: deleteShelf_returnsBadRequest_ifUserCreatedShelfDoesNotExist
methods.description: Verifies that attempting to delete a non-existent shelf returns NOT_FOUND.
